text:
Type: sculptural globe table lamp
Use: soft mood light on a side table, a sideboard or a bedside table; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: white plastic modules, aluminium tripod legs, white cord
Colors: white, warm white glow, silver
Shape: round ball built from curved interlocking petal-like modules, three thin splayed metal legs, layered textured surface, compact but voluminous
Feel: soft, playful, glowing, airy
Goes with: white walls, light wood, pale textiles; Scandinavian, modern or contemporary rooms
